name: create_event
description: Create a new Google Calendar event.

start.description: Start time in RFC3339 format (e.g. 2025-06-15T10:00:00Z) or date for all-day events (e.g. 2025-06-15).

end.description: End time in RFC3339 format or date for all-day events.

attendees.description: Optional comma-separated list of attendee email addresses (e.g. 'alice@example.com, bob@example.com'). Pass 'none' to explicitly send an empty attendees list. Omit this parameter entirely to leave attendees unset. An empty string is an error.

calendar_id.description: Optional ID of the calendar to use. Usually a person's email address (for a shared or colleague calendar). Use list_calendars to see the available calendar IDs. Defaults to the configured calendar if not provided.
